newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Alliance says Reserve Bank Act "must go".
newsitem.headline: NZ Alliance says Reserve Bank Act "must go".

text.p: Jim Anderton, leader of New Zealand's left-wing Alliance Party, said on Friday that the Reserve Bank Act "has to go".
"The sooner that the Reserve Bank Act is changed, the sooner the export sector can look forward to long-term relief," Anderton said in a statement.
"The Reserve Bank Act is the direct cause of exporters' problems. It has to go," he added.
The Act directs the central bank to pursue the goal of price stability, currently defined as zero to two percent inflation.
Anderton was commenting on a summit of exporters this week to discuss the high level of the New Zealand dollar.
Present monetary policy risked driving the economy into recession, Anderton said.
